thread:
maya: CI canary failed on int8-ptq model during structured-output suite. failing rate ~3% but happens almost exclusively when kv-batching is enabled. sample failures look like truncated trailing JSON — usually missing final brace or closing array.

samir: do you have a raw example? can you paste the exact tokenized output?

maya: pasted one below (copied from canary logs):
```
{"action": "create_ticket", "args": {"title": "User crash on login", "priority": "high"}
```

maya: note the missing `}` at the end. it's not always the same field missing. sometimes there's a trailing comma, sometimes an extra "\n" sentinel.

jordan: hypothesis: continuous batching + kv-prefix merging sometimes rewrites sentinel tokens at the stream boundary when using quant kernels that truncate softmax tail. seen similar with PTQ on shorter sequences. disabling batching made failures go to ~0.2% in local repro.

maya: we repro locally by simulating two requests hitting same batch and forcing kvcache interleaving. we also saw the model append an eos-similar token and the parser treats it as content.

samir: can we try small mitigations first: 1) bump parse retry backoff + soft-parse that tries to wrap/close braces automatically 2) run canary with continuous_batching=false 3) enable ktv-sentinel-escape that we've used for other models

maya: tried #1 locally: soft-parse repaired ~30% of fails but it introduced ambiguous mappings for arrays. #2 dropped fails to near-zero. #3 unclear — need infra flag.

ops-bot: Canary deploy 2751234567 -> canary-int8-ptq started by <@maya>. 3 replicas, kv-batching=on.

jordan: for long-term: we should add a structural-entropy check in evaluator that detects likely truncated JSON (unclosed braces/arrays) and routes those tokens through a repair model or forces retry on non-idempotent tool calls. also consider kernel-level fix: ensure streaming splice preserves sentinel tokens by validating token-level alignment when merging KV prefixes.

samir: agree. short-term plan: (A) flip kv-batching=false for this canary run, (B) add a lightweight post-stream validator that attempts deterministic closure (if only closing brace missing) with a 1-retry budget, (C) schedule PTQ quant rerun with kernel patch to avoid tail token truncation.

maya: filing follow-up tickets: ENG-ML #1589 (canary config change), ENG-ML #1590 (post-stream validator), INFRA #462 (kv batching kernel validation). attaching test harness and sample corpus.

jordan: also add telemetry: record token boundary mismatches and map them to parse error class so we can correlate with kernel/seq-len/replica.

maya: thanks — running a new canary with kv-batching=false now. will report results in this thread. :thumbsup:
